subject: english
stem: Why does 'The books on my desk are new' use the?
options: The location identifies a particular set of books.

optionRationales.reason: The shows future time.：冠詞不標示時態。
The location identifies a particular set of books.：on my desk 限定可辨認的一組書。
All plural nouns require the.：一般複數可用零冠詞。
New is a proper name.：new 是形容詞。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「在複數或不可數名詞表一般類別、專有名詞與固定制度性用法時辨識零冠詞，並與特定 the 用法對比。」可推出 The location identifies a particular set of books.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The location identifies a particular set of books. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
